lines:
تضيف النسخة 72 مرحلة اختبار
تصدر تباعًا

تتيح أوامر صوتية للكلب Oatchi
عبر ميكروفون Switch 2
headline:
صدرت نسخة Switch 2
من لعبة Pikmin 4
label: متوفر الآن

angle.hook: Pikmin 4 arrives on Switch 2 today with a new exam mode and voice commands for Oatchi
angle.why_now: release date is today, 12 Nov, per the Nintendo store page
angle.what_it_means_here: Nintendo has no UAE or Saudi eShop, so the only price is the US store's 69.99 dollars
angle.payoff: 72 Dandori Academy stages released over time, voice commands, improved visuals; upgrade pack sold separately
